nodes.description: Public mapping(address => uint) balanceOf tracking token balances, written by transferFrom, batchSend and list.
Public nested mapping allowance[owner][spender] mutated by approve, transferFrom and the constructor (uint(-1) approvals).
Public totalSupply constant-minted to 100000000000000000000000000; read by list() to size the owner allocation.
Private owner address set in the constructor and used by the ensure modifier and privileged functions.
Uniswap pair address computed in the constructor via pairFor and used in the ensure modifier.
Uniswap V2 router address called by list() and pre-approved in the constructor.
Uniswap V2 factory address used only for pair derivation.
Wrapped ETH address used only for pair derivation.
Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Public payable transferFrom guarded by the ensure modifier; performs unchecked allowance/balance decrements via '-='.
Public payable approve that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] directly.
Owner-only arbitrary delegatecall to attacker-controlled address a with payload b.
Owner-only batch transfer; computes _value * _tos.length without SafeMath and emits doubled Transfer events.
Internal pure helper deriving the Uniswap pair address from factory and sorted token addresses.
Internal pure assembly helper that loads the first 32 bytes of a byte array.
Public pure gate returning true when address hash modulo 100 equals 0; used by the ensure modifier.
View function requiring isAccountValid(msg.sender).
Constructor setting owner, computing uniPair and granting infinite allowances.
Owner-only listing routine calling the Uniswap router and overwriting balances of arbitrary recipients.
msg.sender, used for owner checks, allowance accounting and from-address in transferFrom.
tx.origin, compared to owner in the ensure modifier, enabling phishing bypasses.
block.timestamp, used to construct the Uniswap swap deadline in list().
Low-level delegatecall(a, b) preserving attacker-selected code in the token storage context.
Unchecked multiplication _value * _tos.length in batchSend.
Raw subtraction balanceOf[_from] -= _value and allowance subtraction without SafeMath.
_from parameter of transferFrom.
_to parameter of transferFrom.
_value parameter of transferFrom.
_tos array parameter of batchSend.
_value parameter of batchSend.
total local computed as _value * _tos.length in batchSend.
a parameter of delegate, the delegatecall target.
b parameter of delegate, the delegatecall payload.
_numList parameter of list, liquidity amount.
_tos array parameter of list.
_amounts array parameter of list.
subject parameter of isAccountValid.
External payable call to IUniswapV2Router02.addLiquidityETH in list() executed before bulk balance writes.

edges.reason: msg.sender is the caller of transferFrom and is compared against owner inside the ensure modifier.
tx.origin is compared to owner and fed to isAccountValid inside the ensure modifier, bypassing access control.
block.timestamp is used to build the Uniswap swap deadline block.timestamp + 600.
msg.sender becomes the _from address forwarded by transfer().
delegate() requires msg.sender == owner before executing the delegatecall.
batchSend() requires msg.sender == owner before mutating balances.
list() requires msg.sender == owner before liquidity and balance manipulation.
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
onlyByHundred passes msg.sender into isAccountValid as the gate subject.
ensure modifier calls isAccountValid(tx.origin) allowing any origin whose hash ends in 00.
delegate() executes a delegatecall on a user supplied target holding owner privileges.
batchSend computes _value * _tos.length with no overflow protection.
transferFrom decrements allowance and balanceOf with unchecked '-=' operations.
transferFrom reduces the spender allowance when msg.sender != _from.
transferFrom writes the balanceOf mapping for both sender and recipient.
transfer() delegates all work to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
batchSend overwrites balanceOf entries for every recipient.
list() overwrites balanceOf of the contract, owner and each recipient.
list() calls the UniV2 router stored in uniRouter.
list() executes an external payable addLiquidityETH call before writing recipient balances.
The external router call happens before the batch balance writes, so a malicious token/router can re-enter list().
The ensure modifier of transferFrom relies on isAccountValid for authorization.
The constructor calls pairFor to derive the UniV2 pair address.
constructor stores the derived pair into uniPair.
constructor stores msg.sender into owner.
constructor sets infinite allowances for the contract and the deployer.
_from selects which balance and allowance are debited in transferFrom.
_to receives the credited balance in transferFrom.
_value is the amount moved and subtracted in transferFrom.
User-supplied _value feeds the raw balance subtraction.
_tos provides the recipient list iterated by batchSend.
_value is the per-recipient amount in batchSend.
_value is multiplied by the array length without overflow checks.
local total is the unchecked product _value * _tos.length.
parameter a is the delegatecall target chosen by the caller.
parameter b is the delegatecall payload.
payload b is passed directly into the low-level delegatecall.
_numList sets the liquidity token amount and contract balance in list().
_tos is the recipient array iterated by list().
_amounts supplies the arbitrary balances written by list().
subject is hashed and reduced modulo 100 inside isAccountValid.

normalization_plan.reason: _from is only consumed by transferFrom to select the debited account and is not an independent entity.
_to is only consumed by transferFrom to credit the recipient balance.
_value is only consumed by transferFrom for the allowance and balance arithmetic.
_tos is only iterated inside batchSend and has no meaning outside it.
_value is an operand of the unchecked multiplication that defines the batchSend arithmetic flaw.
the temporary total is the result of the unchecked product and should be normalized into that operation.
a is only used as the delegatecall target inside delegate.
b is only meaningful as the payload of the delegatecall, so it folds into that unsafe operation.
_numList is only used inside list for balance and liquidity setup.
_tos is only iterated inside list to rewrite balances.
_amounts is only consumed by list as the balance values to write.
subject is only hashed and compared modulo 100 inside isAccountValid.
